concepts.name: 橘帽踢步客
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one new full-body walking character concept for the oneBeat 2D comic cast.
Input images: Images 1, 2 and 3 are STYLE, COLOR and PROPORTION REFERENCES ONLY (lilroll, mismatch, wave). Invent a new distinct human character, not a restyled copy of any reference.
Primary request: design one cool human-like streetwear character whose exaggerated WALKING pose feels naturally part of these three characters' cast. Slightly quirky-cute, with non-realistic colored skin permitted.
Style: match the reference images closely: confident hand-inked variable black outer contours, finer interior fold lines, restrained short directional hatching, saturated flat cel colors with a few simple shadow planes. Large expressive head, compact torso, chunky clothing and substantial shoes, roughly 4–4.5 heads tall like the reference cast, not toddler chibi, not tall realistic fashion illustration. Simple readable features with half-lidded eyes and cool unbothered expression. No smile; no mouth needed.
Palette: the cast's punchy violet, cyan/turquoise, tangerine red/orange, sunny yellow, black and ivory blocks. Clear saturated color relationships, not washed-out earthy tones. Do not use every color everywhere; keep each outfit focused.
Composition: exactly one whole character on a square canvas, generous margins; hairstyle, hands and entire shoes fully visible. Eye-level camera ONLY, no overhead or low angle. Side-on or very slight three-quarter side view moving toward screen-right. Nose, visible pupil and gaze point straight ahead toward screen-right, never toward the viewer. Keep feet shown from the side with minimal perspective distortion.
Action: a dramatically stylized but readable walking phase with a very large stride/gesture. At least one planted foot touching the ground; not running, flying, skateboarding or jumping. Exaggeration belongs to walking rhythm, not an action-fight pose.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background. Only the character and a tiny low contact shadow made of charcoal ink strokes beneath the planted shoe. No background scenery, solid white or black background, checkerboard pixels, glow, floor strip or cast-colored halo.
Avoid: photorealism, 3D, clay, soft toy, glossy rendering, generic smooth vector sticker art, anime glamour proportions, robot/object-headed characters, giant sparkling eyes, smiles, looking at camera, extra props, any logos, words, name labels, badges, frames or watermark. One concept per image, not a montage.
Character and action specification:
Concept: a lavender-skinned youthful human with shaggy short ink-black hair partly tucked beneath an oversized tangerine bucket hat with an irregular floppy brim. Slanted half-lidded eye, relaxed cool face with no mouth. Roomy cobalt/cyan color-block windbreaker with black zip details over an ivory shirt; sunny yellow baggy knee-length cargo shorts, black crew socks, chunky violet and ivory sneakers with a small orange accent. Shape language: floppy round hat, boxy jacket, long bare shins.
Pose: an extremely long swaggering walk like reference 2 but with a new silhouette: the forward leg kicks nearly straight out toward screen-right at roughly knee/hip height, foot flexed toe-up; rear leg is diagonally extended down-left with the full sneaker planted. Torso leans slightly backward to balance. One elbow bends strongly forward in counter-swing, the other hand trails behind. This is the peak of a jaunty marching step, not a fighting kick; hands relaxed and cool. Keep the character's head profile facing forward, not turned to the camera.
